title: Criminal penalties.
bodyText: Unless otherwise provided, any person who violates this chapter shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
bodyHtml: §145-12  Criminal penalties.  Unless otherwise provided, any person who violates this chapter shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. [L 1951, c 74, pt of §1; RL 1955, §23-12; HRS §145-12; am L 2025, c 235, §28]
